title: Search and inspect the CRM case library
summary: List cases, search their current text lexically, or inspect an exact immutable current or historical revision with stage, summary, advisory, and its source-update correlation visible.
use_when: Existing employment-oriented cases should be found before starting or updating work.
The current state or one exact historical revision of a known case should be inspected.
A case's immutable revision lineage and evidence boundary should be reviewed.
do_not_use_when: New information should be recorded or hidden steward work resumed or retried.
The caller needs a semantic people search, live source refresh, contact recommendation guarantee, or proof of an external interaction.
A case advisory should be used to block an otherwise valid operation.
outcome: A deterministic bounded list or lexical search over current case heads, or one exact case revision or complete revision history whose CRM claims, advisory, source-update correlation, and evidence limits remain explicit.
effects: Case list, show, history, and search make no CRM domain mutation and invoke no model, Nucleus job, source, browser, network, or hidden worker; database opening may enforce private file/sidecar permissions and WAL mode.
Human or JSON output may disclose private case Markdown, summaries, stages, advisories, and stable source-update references to the caller or redirected output.
authority: CRM owns stored case and revision identity, immutable order, stage/advisory state, deterministic read projection, and source-update correlation.
The caller and cited sources retain authority for external facts; the reader owns whether the stored material is relevant and whether a real-world action is appropriate.
success: The selected database is an initialized supported schema-one CRM database and the bounded read completes without integrity or identity error.
An omitted case revision selects the current head, while an explicit positive revision selects exactly that immutable snapshot.

Search performs one case-insensitive literal-substring match over title, current Markdown, and current advisory, orders by most-recently updated case then identity, and never claims semantic confidence or source freshness.
Every returned revision includes its stage, summary and nullable advisory; every non-null advisory is conspicuous on human and machine consumption surfaces.
failure_and_recovery: Run crm doctor against the same database when schema, integrity, permission, or Nucleus/toolset readiness is uncertain.
A no-match result means only that the selected stored current heads did not match the lexical query; it does not establish that no useful person, company, role, or relationship exists.
Resolve mutable external facts through their source before relying on them for real-world action.
privacy: CRM state and output may expose private contact, employment, interaction, source, summary, advisory, and agent-correlation data.
The CLI performs no network or model call for reads, but redirected output becomes caller-owned retained data.
does_not_authorize: Treating a stage or generated summary as permission, a guarantee, or independently verified real-world truth.
Hiding a non-null advisory, fetching a cited source, contacting a person, or changing case state.
Treating lexical rank as semantic similarity, contact worthiness, or complete coverage.

consumers.statement: A local reader may list or lexically search current case heads and inspect one exact current or historical case revision and its lineage.

preconditions.statement: The selected path is an initialized supported schema-one CRM database and the caller supplies a valid bounded read, query, and optional positive limit or revision.

inputs.statement: Inputs are an optional positive result limit, a lexical query, or one case identity with an optional exact positive revision.

outputs.statement: Outputs are deterministic current-head summaries or exact immutable revisions carrying stage, summary, nullable advisory, and stored source-update correlation in human text or the documented ok/data JSON envelope.

data_semantics.statement: Search is case-insensitive literal-substring matching over stored title, current Markdown, and current advisory; revisions are complete CRM snapshots, source-update IDs are stored correlations, and advisories are visible warnings rather than gates.

identity_and_units.statement: Case ID identifies one lineage, a positive case-local revision selects one immutable complete snapshot, and lexical ordering is retrieval behavior rather than a confidence score.
The read capability defines no pricing, probability, contact score, or physical unit.

completeness_and_freshness.statement: An exact revision read is complete for that committed snapshot; history covers the retained lineage; list and search cover only current heads in the selected database up to their explicit limits.
CRM does not refresh sources or prove that a stored person, title, role, posting, interaction, or outcome remains current externally.

access.statement: The supported read boundary is the local CRM CLI against an explicitly selected private database; direct SQLite and cited-source access are not consumer interfaces.

lifecycle_and_consistency.statement: Reads make no case-domain mutation, historical revisions are immutable, omitted revision selects the committed current head, and unchanged database state yields deterministic projections; opening may tighten database/sidecar permissions and select WAL mode.

operational_limits.statement: Search is bounded lexical retrieval over retained current heads and does not invoke a model, source adapter, network, browser, Nucleus, or hidden worker; version 0.1 has no raw-delivery, request, or receipt export command.
No maximum database size, wall-clock latency, semantic recall, or source coverage service level is promised.

compatibility_and_evolution.statement: Capability contract version 1 reads database schema one and emits the documented ok/data or ok/error JSON envelope while preserving public case and revision identities.
No future schema migration window or cross-release search-ranking stability is promised.

reliances.statement: Library reads invoke no Nucleus job, model, network service, Chancery runtime, or cited source system.
